Name: Dark Elf
Description: Also known as "Dunmer" in their homeland of Morrowind, the Dark Elves are noted for their skilled and balanced integration of the sword, the bow and destruction magic. They are resistant to fire and can summon an ancestral ghost for aid.
Origins:
Vvardenfell: You are a true child of Vvardenfell. Amongst the volcanic wasteland you were taught that resilience is the greatest of all Dunmer quality.

Mainland: As a Dunmer on the mainland you grew amongst all kind of traders, you learned all there was to know about negotiations and how to can make people react the way you need them to.
